messages.note_how: Ask Aruna: "take me to Tokyo", "fly to Paris", "take me anywhere". On a trip: "tell me about this city", "teach me a phrase", "next station", "louder", "quieter", "what time is it there", "where am I", "go home". Any key, or "skip", skips the flight.
messages.note_credits: Radio stations: Radio Browser (radio-browser.info). City facts: Wikipedia. Weather and city search: Open-Meteo.com.
messages.note_privacy: Only the destination's name and point go to these services; your own place stays on this computer (the distance is worked out here).
